name: custom-mcps
description: Standalone MCP servers by jahirtrap (pixel art, sound effects, conventions, translations, study, 3D design, mod workspaces), each installable as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: buildkit
plugins.description: Design low-poly 3D structures by data: principles, references, spec, iso and silhouette preview, Godot def.

plugins.name: devkit
plugins.description: Development conventions plus the checks that verify them: commits, hardcoded tokens, spacing, format and duplication.

plugins.name: i18n
plugins.description: Keep translation locales in sync, complete and consistent (read-only): key diff, completeness, placeholders, unused keys.

plugins.name: modkit
plugins.description: Inspect and validate multiloader Minecraft mod workspaces (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge): list, inspect, loader sync, structure and JSON checks.

plugins.name: pixelart
plugins.description: Draw, inspect and verify pixel art by data, any size, with an upscaled preview you can actually read.

plugins.name: sfx
plugins.description: Synthesize sound effects (.ogg) by data, any kind, with a waveform image to check them at a glance.

plugins.name: study
plugins.description: Academic study work by data: anti-AI writing checks, APA citations, concept maps, typeset PDFs and decks, free-image sourcing, multi-area workspaces.
